decisions.reason: The candidate already has same-message DEFER and MODIFY Events that place Transak-dependent wallet provisioning after launch; no additional change is required.
The candidate was already deferred and its same-message MODIFY adds POST_LAUNCH to the Transak integration scope, fully representing the source decision.
Deferring Transak until after launch does not change the primary-sale allocation amounts or the existing treatment of fiat fees.
The decision changes Transak launch timing, not the $15 primary mint price or advertised price commitment.

The FAQ contains Transak-specific fiat-buyer instructions, but the source does not establish whether that content should be hidden until Transak launches, published as a forthcoming flow, or remain unchanged.
Proceeding initially with crypto does not change the unlimited NFT ebook mint behavior.
The optional tipping behavior is independent of whether Transak is available at launch.
The current About-page state does not promise day-one Transak availability and remains valid unchanged.
The Mission-page content does not depend on day-one Transak availability.
The statement that the initial audience will be crypto users reinforces but does not modify the existing SIWE requirement for crypto mint and transfer flows.
Delaying Transak does not alter automatic prize transfer, payment destination, or winner-notification behavior.
The certificate and confirmation-email behavior remains valid for applicable purchases; the source changes when Transak purchases become available, not the email contents or read-link behavior.
